meta.name: writing-fragments
meta.description: Writing, explore — mine raw fragments, no structure yet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 挖掘并整理零散的写作素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有零散想法需要梳理成写作素材
copy.tagline_en: Mine and organize raw writing fragments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have scattered ideas to turn into writing material

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会不断追问你想写什么，把对话中出现的任何好句子、想法、比喻等碎片收集到一个 Markdown 文件中，不整理结构。
howto.when: 当你告诉 Claude 你想写点东西（比如文章、故事），但没有明确要求它帮你搭框架或写完整文章时触发。

say.text: 我想写一篇关于远程办公的文章，先帮我收集一些想法碎片。
我有个关于“数字游民”的比喻，帮我记下来。
say.note: Claude 会把你的比喻作为碎片保存。

say.text: 把刚才那个关于效率的句子也加进去。
say.note: Claude 会追加该句子到碎片文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will relentlessly interview you about what you want to write, capturing any sharp sentences, ideas, metaphors, etc. that emerge in conversation into a single Markdown file, without imposing structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you tell Claude you want to write something (e.g., an article, story) without asking it to outline or write a full piece.

say_en.text: I want to write about remote work. Help me collect some fragments.
say_en.note: Claude will start interviewing you and append fragments to the file.

say_en.text: I have a metaphor about 'digital nomads'. Save it.
say_en.note: Claude will save your metaphor as a fragment.

say_en.text: Add that sentence about productivity too.
say_en.note: Claude will append that sentence to the fragment file.
